title: Sleep in Orbit
hook: Your brain uses 20% of your energy.

beats.label: After ten minutes
beats.line: Your body fluids shift upward, causing facial puffiness.
beats.idea: Character's cheeks swell as fluids move to the head.

beats.label: After twenty-four hours
beats.line: Your heart pumps more blood per beat, increasing stroke volume.
beats.idea: A heart icon beats slower on a monitor.

beats.label: By day three
beats.line: Your muscles start to weaken from lack of load.
beats.idea: Arm muscles shrink slightly, showing reduced size.

beats.label: After a week
beats.line: Your spine stretches, adding a couple of centimeters to your height.
beats.idea: Character measures height, a ruler shows a tiny increase.

beats.label: Six months in
beats.line: Your immune cells become less active, increasing infection risk.
beats.idea: White blood cells appear sluggish in a close-up.

description: A quick look at how microgravity changes your body while you snooze in space.

facts.claim: Effect of spaceflight on the human body

end.line: Float and nap, would you try?

topic: What happens if you sleep in orbit around Earth?
